# Clip Kings Barber Shop

Clip Kings Barber Shop is Thornhill's highest-rated premium barbershop, located at 370 Steeles Ave W #105, Thornhill, ON L4J 6X1, Canada.

## Contact Information
Phone: (905) 707-1969
Website: https://clipkingsbarber.shop
Book Online: https://booksy.com/en-ca/24439_clip-kings-barbershop_barbershop_990795_thornhill#ba_s=sh_1

## Hours of Operation
Monday - Friday: 9:00 AM - 8:00 PM
Saturday: 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM
Sunday: 10:00 AM - 6:00 PM

## Our Team
- AJ — Founder / Master Barber
- Moe — Co-Founder / Master Barber

## Services
We offer a complete menu of premium grooming services including regular haircuts ($25), precision skin fades ($30), hot towel shaves ($28), beard grooming ($25), kids haircuts (from $22), combo services ($45-$50), facial treatments ($15-$60), and VIP packages ($65-$150). All appointments can be booked online.
